title: In 2018, a Hawaii study found green roofs stayed cooler than white roofs in Honolulu
summary_full: A University of Hawaii study found green roofs stayed cooler than white roofs.  The green roof's average daytime surface temperature was 4.1°F lower.  Peak temperatures on the green roof were 18.5°F lower than the white roof.  Evapotranspiration from plants cooled the surrounding air significantly.  This vegetation offers a method to combat urban heat island effects.
